description_zh: 两组各六句连贯讲话。第二组由助手将本页中文译为固定英文稿，用于控制合成变量；这不是实时中文语音识别或翻译准确率测试。姓名、号码和场景均为合成测试内容。

passages.title_zh: 第一组：六句连贯英文 · 维修预约
sentences: Hello, thank you for calling, and I hope you are having a good afternoon.
I am calling about the repair appointment we discussed earlier this week.
The front door opens normally, but it does not close all the way.
I can be at home on Thursday morning, between nine and eleven.
Before we confirm the visit, please tell me the total price and how long the repair will take.
If you need any other information, I can send a photo after this call.
meanings_zh: 你好，谢谢你来电，希望你今天下午过得愉快。
我打电话是想谈一下我们这周早些时候讨论的维修预约。
前门可以正常打开，但是关不严。
周四上午九点到十一点之间，我可以在家。
确认上门之前，请告诉我总价，以及维修需要多长时间。
如果你还需要其他信息，我可以在通话结束后发一张照片。
critical_checks: does not close all the way

passages.title_zh: 第二组：六句中文对应英文译文 · 清洁预约
source_sentences: 你好，我想预约明天下午三点，不是今天下午。
我家有两个房间需要清洁，其中一个房间里有一块比较大的地毯。
请先告诉我全部费用，并说明是否包括材料费和上门费。
如果整个工作需要超过两个小时，请提前告诉我，这样我好调整安排。
我的联系电话最后四位是二四六八，请不要记成二八四六。
如果明天下午没有空位，周五上午十点也可以，谢谢。
sentences: Hello, I would like to book an appointment for three tomorrow afternoon, not this afternoon.
There are two rooms in my home that need cleaning, and one of them has a fairly large carpet.
Please tell me the total cost first, and let me know whether supplies and the service visit are included.
If the whole job will take more than two hours, please let me know in advance so I can adjust my schedule.
The last four digits of my phone number are two four six eight, not two eight four six.
If you have no openings tomorrow afternoon, ten on Friday morning would also work for me, thank you.
critical_checks: three tomorrow afternoon, not this afternoon
two four six eight, not two eight four six
